Class FileUtils

java.lang.Object
org.teche.merv.client.utils.FileUtils
public class FileUtils extends Object
Utility class for file operations in Merv Client. Provides methods for writing files and managing file system operations.

      public static void writeFile(String filePath, String content) throws IOException
      Write content to a file at the specified path. Creates parent directories if they don't exist.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the path where the file should be written
      content - the content to write to the file
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs
